organised for men in the parish, the plan is to set up a men’s friendship group, a bit like the men’s shed co ncept, but more focused on broader activities such as sports, hobbies/crafts, cooking skills, healthcare, wellbeing, benefits entitlement, quiz competitions, board games, visits to tourist attractions, day trips to interesting venues such as herita ge/religious sites, or simply just prayers at holy communion spiritual holy communion prayer my jesus, i believe that you are present in the most blessed sacrament. i love you above all things and i desire to receive you into my soul. since i cannot now receive you sacramentally, come at least spiritually into my heart. i embrace you as if you have already come, and unite myself wholly to you. never permit me to be separated from you. amen. composed by saint alphonsus liguori anima christi prayer to the most holy redeemer soul of christ, sanctify me. body of christ, save me. blood of christ, embolden me. water from the side of christ, wash me. passion of christ, strengthen me. ogood jesus, hear me. within your wounds hide me. never permit me to be separated from you. from the evil enemy defend me. at the hour of my death call me and bid me to come to you, that with your saints i may praise you for amen prayer online : come and join us at…
